name: BrickBuilder AI
original_description: Create and edit LEGO-compatible brick models from text descriptions. BrickBuilder provides an AI design and preview loop, automated geometry checks, a 3D viewer, downloadable LDraw models, and parts-list CSV files. Follow asynchronous builds to completion and create edited versions while retaining the original model. Requires a connected BrickBuilder account. Geometry checks do not guarantee physical buildability. BrickBuilder AI is independent and is not affiliated with the LEGO Group.
summary_ja: 文章からLEGO互換ブロックのモデルを作成・編集する。
limitations_ja: 接続済みアカウントが必要。形状チェックは実物として組み立てられることを保証しない。LEGO Groupとは無関係。
